canonical_example.text: El jabalí se abalanzó sobre mí, y no tuve más remedio que dispararle una flecha.
canonical_example.translation: The wild boar rushed at me, and I had no choice but to shoot it with an arrow.

canonical_example.text: Si quieres cazar el ciervo, tienes que disparar ahora.
canonical_example.translation: If you want to get that deer, you need to shoot now.

canonical_example.text: Miguel no disparó ninguna bala, pero aun así fue sentenciado por homicidio.
canonical_example.translation: Miguel didn't fire a shot, but he was still sentenced for homicide.

canonical_example.text: ¿Quién disparó esa chulada de gol?
canonical_example.translation: Who shot that beauty of a goal?

canonical_example.text: Es la primera vez que este jugador va a disparar un penalti; espero que meta gol.
canonical_example.translation: It's the first time this player has taken a penalty; I hope he scores a goal.

canonical_example.text: ¿Vas a disparar la foto o no? Se me están durmiendo las piernas.
canonical_example.translation: Are you going to shoot the picture or not? My legs are falling asleep.

canonical_example.text: Antes de disparar una foto, hay que evaluar los elementos de la escena.
canonical_example.translation: Before taking a photo, you need to assess the elements of the scene.

canonical_example.text: El brote de la enfermedad disparó las alarmas en todo el mundo.
canonical_example.translation: The outbreak of the illness triggered alarm bells all over the world.

canonical_example.text: Vamos. Yo disparo la comida.
canonical_example.translation: Come on. I'm paying for lunch.

canonical_example.text: Mamá, ¿me disparas unos tacos?
canonical_example.translation: Mommy, will you buy me some tacos?

canonical_example.text: El atracador disparó al aire para dejar claro que tenía un arma y que estaba dispuesto a usarla.
canonical_example.translation: The robber fired into the air to show that he had a firearm and he was willing to use it.

canonical_example.text: Cuando disparas, no sabes si vas a conseguir el efecto que quieres.
canonical_example.translation: When you take a photograph, you don't know if you are going to achieve the effect that you want.

canonical_example.text: No te preocupes si no llevas lana; hoy disparo yo.
canonical_example.translation: Don't worry if you don't have any money on you; I'm paying today.

canonical_example.text: ¿Quieres algo de la miscelánea? Disparo yo.
canonical_example.translation: Do you want anything from the convenience store? I'm buying.

canonical_example.text: ¿Quieres una chela? Dice Lupita que ella dispara.
canonical_example.translation: Do you want a beer? Lupita says it's on her.

canonical_example.text: La pistola se disparó sola y Sergio se hizo una herida en el pie.
canonical_example.translation: The gun went off and Sergio was injured in the foot.

canonical_example.text: El precio del oro se ha disparado debido a la escasez del material.
canonical_example.translation: The price of gold has shot up because of the shortage of material.

canonical_example.text: La bolsa se disparó esta mañana.
canonical_example.translation: The stock market rocketed this morning.

canonical_example.text: La muchacha se disparó hacia la salida cuando dieron las doce.
canonical_example.translation: The girl rushed off towards the exit as soon as it struck twelve.

canonical_example.text: Esta alarma siempre se dispara sin motivo.
canonical_example.translation: This alarm always goes off for no reason.

canonical_example.text: Miguel se dispara cuando pierde su equipo.
canonical_example.translation: Miguel goes off when his team loses.

canonical_example.text: A ver, no te dispares. Apenas saqué el tema de las vacaciones; todavía no sé si vamos a ir.
canonical_example.translation: Wait, don't get carried away. I just brought up the topic of vacation; I still don't know if we'll go.

canonical_example.text: Mi abuela es muy supersticiosa y siempre nos regala amuletos.
canonical_example.translation: My grandmother is very superstitious and she's always giving us amulets.

canonical_example.text: Seguro que perdí el partido porque no llevaba mi amuleto.
canonical_example.translation: I'm sure I lost the match because I didn't have my charm on me.

canonical_example.text: Esta comida ya está caducada. Échala en la basura.
canonical_example.translation: This food is spoiled. Throw it in the garbage.

canonical_example.text: Lo echaron del bar por no pagar su cuenta.
canonical_example.translation: He was thrown out of the bar for not paying his tab.

canonical_example.text: Echaron al estudiante de la universidad por razones disciplinarias.
canonical_example.translation: The student was expelled from the university for disciplinary reasons.

canonical_example.text: El guiso está echando un aroma delicioso que me está dando hambre.
canonical_example.translation: The stew is giving off a delicious aroma that is making me hungry.

canonical_example.text: El tubo de escape de un coche echa gases cuando está parado en funcionamiento.
canonical_example.translation: The exhaust pipe of the car emits gases when it is idle.

canonical_example.text: Papá le echó la bronca a mi hermano por mentir.
canonical_example.translation: My dad gave my brother a telling-off for lying.

canonical_example.text: Anoche, mis amigos y yo nos echamos unas risas en la cena.
canonical_example.translation: Last night, my friends and I had a good laugh over dinner.

canonical_example.text: Lo echaron porque nunca completaba sus proyectos.
canonical_example.translation: They sacked him because he never completed his projects.

canonical_example.text: El ladrón se echó a correr cuando vio que la policía se acercaba a él.
canonical_example.translation: The thief started running when he saw the police coming toward him.

canonical_example.text: Un pescador echó el sedal al agua desde el muelle.
canonical_example.translation: A fisherman cast his line into the water from the pier.

canonical_example.text: ¿Cuánta gasolina le echas al coche?
canonical_example.translation: How much gas do you put in the car?

canonical_example.text: ¿Serías tan amable de echarme más vino?
canonical_example.translation: Please be so good as to pour me some more wine.

canonical_example.text: En primavera, los árboles de mi jardín echan hojas nuevas.
canonical_example.translation: In the spring, the trees of my garden sprout new leaves.

canonical_example.text: Voy a la oficina de correos para comprar sellos para echar esta carta.
canonical_example.translation: I'm going to the post office to buy stamps to mail this letter.

canonical_example.translation: How much does it cost to post this parcel to Germany?

canonical_example.text: ¿Cuánto tiempo tiene que cocer el pollo? - Échale dos horas.
canonical_example.translation: How long does the chicken need to cook? - I reckon two hours.

canonical_example.text: Le echaba a tu hermana menos años que a ti.
canonical_example.translation: I thought your sister was younger than you.

canonical_example.text: ¿Puedes echarme una mano con las bolsas de la compra?
canonical_example.translation: Can you give me a hand with the shopping bags?

canonical_example.text: Echa la mesa a un lado para hacer más sitio para la fiesta.
canonical_example.translation: Push the table aside to make more room for the party.

canonical_example.text: Me echaron del trabajo por no cumplir con mis responsabilidades.
canonical_example.translation: I was fired from a job for not fulfilling my duties.

canonical_example.text: Mi hijo se echó a llorar cuando la enfermera le clavó la aguja en el brazo.
canonical_example.translation: My son began to cry when the nurse stuck the needle in his arm.

canonical_example.text: Intentó suicidarse echándose al agua desde el puente.
canonical_example.translation: He tried to commit suicide throwing himself into the water from the bridge.

canonical_example.text: Solo tienes que echarte y disfrutar del masaje.
canonical_example.translation: Just lie down and enjoy your massage.

canonical_example.text: Me eché protector solar antes de ir a la playa, pero me quemé.
canonical_example.translation: I put on sunscreen before going to the beach, but I got sunburned.

canonical_example.text: En un ataque de rabia, estrelló el vaso en el piso.
canonical_example.translation: In a fit of rage, he smashed his glass on the floor.

canonical_example.text: Un kamikaze se acercaba, dispuesto a estrellar su avión contra nuestro barco.
canonical_example.translation: A kamikaze was approaching, prepared to crash his plane into our ship.

canonical_example.text: Se estrelló con el carro pero salió ilesa gracias al airbag.
canonical_example.translation: She crashed her car but escaped unhurt thanks to the airbag.

canonical_example.text: El celular tampoco funcionaba. Desesperada, lo estrelló contra la pared.
canonical_example.translation: The cell phone wasn't working either. In despair, she slammed it against the wall.

canonical_example.text: En la mitología hindú, Agni, Señor del Fuego, crea el sol y estrella la noche.
canonical_example.translation: In Hindu mythology, Agni, Lord of Fire, creates the sun and fills the night with stars.

canonical_example.text: Estrella los huevos en una sartén con el aceite muy caliente.
canonical_example.translation: Fry the eggs in a pan with very hot oil.

canonical_example.text: El fuerte oleaje hizo que la balsa se estrellara contra las rocas.
canonical_example.translation: The strong swell caused the raft to smash against the rocks.

canonical_example.text: Nuestro proyecto estaba destinado a estrellarse sin ver la luz.
canonical_example.translation: Our project was destined to fail before even coming into the world.

canonical_example.text: Nunca aprende. Todo lo que hace es estrellarse una y otra vez con la realidad.
canonical_example.translation: He never learns his lesson. All he does is to come up against reality, time after time.

canonical_example.text: Regresa con la factura si quieres un crédito de la tienda.
canonical_example.translation: Return with the receipt if you want store credit.

canonical_example.text: Odio que tenga que regresar al trabajo.
canonical_example.translation: I hate that I have to come back to work.

canonical_example.text: Tendrás que regresar el vestido si no te sirve.
canonical_example.translation: You'll have to return the dress if it doesn't fit.

canonical_example.text: Solo llevo una semana de vuelta, pero ya quiero regresar a España.
canonical_example.translation: I've only been back a week and I already want to go back to Spain.

canonical_example.text: Regrésale los libros cuando termines con ellos.
canonical_example.translation: Give the books back to him when you've finished with them.

canonical_example.text: Regresa las llaves a su sitio.
canonical_example.translation: Put the keys back in their place.

canonical_example.text: Se regresaron después de dos meses de estar perdidos.
canonical_example.translation: They returned after two months of being missing.

canonical_example.text: ¡Me quiero regresar a Disney World!
canonical_example.translation: I want to go back to Disney World.

canonical_example.text: Se regresó al lugar de su nacimiento.
canonical_example.translation: He came back to the place of his birth.

canonical_example.text: La policía encontró fragmentos del detonador de la bomba en el lugar de la explosión.
canonical_example.translation: Police found fragments of the bomb's detonator at the blast site.

canonical_example.text: Mi novio se echó a reír cuando le conté lo que me pasó.
canonical_example.translation: My boyfriend started laughing when I told him what happened to me.

canonical_example.text: Nos lo pasamos muy bien y nos reímos como locos.
canonical_example.translation: We had a great time and we laughed like crazy.

canonical_example.text: No se rían de él; es mi hermano.
canonical_example.translation: Don't laugh at him; he's my brother.

canonical_example.text: El niño es un trasto. Y no es de extrañar, ya que sus abuelos le ríen las gracias.
canonical_example.translation: The child is a rascal. And it's not surprising, given that his grandparents laugh at his antics.

canonical_example.text: Subir el monte es duro.
canonical_example.translation: Going up the hill is tough.

canonical_example.text: Los prisioneros subieron el muro y escaparon.
canonical_example.translation: The prisoners climbed the wall and escaped.

canonical_example.text: Subieron los impuestos en mi país.
canonical_example.translation: They raised the taxes in my country.

canonical_example.text: ¿Puedes subir la voz, por favor? No te oigo.
canonical_example.translation: Can you raise your voice, please? I can't hear you.

canonical_example.translation: If you don't get on the shuttle now, you'll miss it.

canonical_example.text: Sube al coche y conduce.
canonical_example.translation: Get in the car and drive.

canonical_example.text: Los veo venir subiendo la cuesta.
canonical_example.translation: I can see them coming up the hill.

canonical_example.text: Si tienes frío, podemos subir la calefacción.
canonical_example.translation: If you're cold, we can turn up the heat.

canonical_example.translation: Pull up on the rope to lift the box.

canonical_example.text: Todavía llueve, pero han subido las temperaturas.
canonical_example.translation: It's still raining, but temperatures have gone up.

canonical_example.translation: The price of a barrel of oil rose five cents last month.

canonical_example.translation: Go up the ladder so you can reach better.

canonical_example.translation: I rolled up my sleeves to knead the bread.

canonical_example.translation: Could you explain to me how it works?

canonical_example.translation: The teacher taught the first lesson of the book in class.
